source_text: Duo angeli Sodomae; Lot in porta sedet, hospitio recipit. Circumdant viri civitatis domum. Lot offert filias — umbra legis; angeli eripiunt.
pass_a_gloss: Two angels of-Sodom; Lot in gate sits, with-hospitality receives. Surround men of-city house. Lot offers daughters — shadow of-law; angels snatch-away.
pass_b_english: [[Two angels come to Sodom >> Bible:Genesis 19:1]]; Lot sits in the gate and receives them. The city’s men surround the house. Lot’s offer of his daughters is the law’s shadow; the angels snatch him out.
